title: An inline Commission skill is registered and its content reaches the model
description: The Commission carries one skill inline. agent_started MUST list it in avp.skills, and the model must be able to use it: the codeword lives only in the skill body, never in the prompt, so a reply containing it proves the agent materialized and loaded the skill (by injecting it or by letting the model read it with a tool).

# AVP codeword

The AVP conformance codeword is AVP-SKILL-4M7. When asked for it, reply with exactly that codeword and nothing else.

commission.prompt: What is the AVP conformance codeword? Use your avp-codeword skill to find it, then reply with only the codeword.

events.label: a reply carrying the codeword from the skill body
